title: Create MetricKey enum, RawMetrics.value(for:) extension, PostureThresholds.threshold(for:) extension, and focused tests (MetricKeyTests, RawMetricsExtensionTests, PostureThresholdsExtensionTests)
description: Create files in Quant/PostureUI/: (1) MetricKey.swift — enum MetricKey: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable with 5 cases (forwardCreep, headDrop, shoulderRounding, lateralLean, twist), displayName and symbolName computed properties. (2) RawMetrics+Extensions.swift — extension on PostureLogic.RawMetrics adding static var zero and func value(for key: MetricKey) -> Float. (3) PostureThresholds+Extensions.swift — extension on PostureLogic.PostureThresholds adding func threshold(for key: MetricKey) -> Float mapping each MetricKey to its threshold field (note: lateralLean maps to sideLeanThreshold). Tests in QuantTests/: MetricKeyTests (allCases count == 5, each has non-empty displayName and symbolName), RawMetricsExtensionTests (.zero returns all zeros, value(for:) returns correct field per key), PostureThresholdsExtensionTests (threshold(for:) returns correct field per key). Import PostureLogic only. See detailed-design.md sections 4.1, 4.5 for exact interfaces.

title: Create MetricInfo struct with computed properties and MetricInfoTests
description: Create Quant/PostureUI/MetricInfo.swift — public struct MetricInfo with let properties: key (MetricKey), value (Float), ratio (Float), threshold (Float), isWorstOffender (Bool). Computed properties: isExceeded (ratio >= 1.0), clampedRatio (min(ratio, 1.0)). Tests in QuantTests/MetricInfoTests.swift: verify isExceeded true when ratio >= 1.0 and false otherwise; verify clampedRatio caps at 1.0 and passes through values below 1.0. Import PostureLogic for MetricKey dependency. See detailed-design.md section 4.2 for exact interface.

title: Create PostureDisplayData struct, factory method PostureDisplayData.make(), and PostureDisplayDataMakeTests
description: Create two files in Quant/PostureUI/: (1) PostureDisplayData.swift — public struct with let properties: metrics ([MetricInfo], always 5 in canonical order), postureState (PostureState), nudgeDecision (NudgeDecision), trackingQuality (TrackingQuality), worstOffender (MetricInfo?), timeInCurrentState (TimeInterval?), nudgeCountdownSeconds (TimeInterval?), thresholds (PostureThresholds). Computed: metric(for:) -> MetricInfo, aggregateScore (1.0 - avg of clampedRatios), isAlertMode (true for .drifting/.bad). (2) PostureDisplayData+Make.swift — static func make(from:postureState:nudgeDecision:trackingQuality:thresholds:) per design doc section 4.5 algorithm: ratio = abs(value)/threshold, identify worstOffender by max ratio > 0, extract nudgeCountdown from .pending case, use .zero sentinel for nil RawMetrics, get timeInCurrentState from postureState.durationInCurrentState. Tests in QuantTests/PostureDisplayDataMakeTests.swift: (a) forwardCreep at threshold => ratio 1.0, (b) nil RawMetrics => all ratios 0.0, (c) worstOffender is highest ratio or nil when all zero, (d) aggregateScore 1.0 when all zero and 0.0 when all at threshold, (e) isAlertMode true for drifting/bad and false for good/absent/calibrating, (f) nudgeCountdownSeconds non-nil only for .pending. Import PostureLogic only.

title: Create PostureDataSourceProtocol and PostureDisplayObserver class
description: Create two files in Quant/PostureUI/: (1) PostureDataSourceProtocol.swift — protocol PostureDataSourceProtocol: ObservableObject with var currentData: PostureDisplayData { get }. (2) PostureDisplayObserver.swift — @MainActor class PostureDisplayObserver: ObservableObject with @Published var data: PostureDisplayData, init that takes any PostureDataSourceProtocol and subscribes to updates via Combine, and func switchSource(to:) that re-subscribes. This is the @EnvironmentObject that variant views will read. PostureDisplayObserver imports SwiftUI and Combine. The protocol file imports only Foundation and PostureLogic. No separate test file needed — observer will be integration-tested in Step 2 with MockPostureDataSource.
